description: Read one Game Kit: its manifest (provides / requires capabilities, asset slots, data collections, events), README docs, config JSON schema with defaults, version and changelog (information only: projects always run the latest version), and summary { tagline, tags, targets, status, cover, coverUrl } with the featured image URL. Pass with_usage=true to also list the workspace projects that have it installed. Call this BEFORE gripforge_gamekit_configure to know which config keys exist. 0 credits.

id.description: Kit id from the catalogue, dotted (e.g. vehicle.driveable, mission.objectives).

section.description: api: also return `api`, the full API reference of the kit (config with units and limits, hooks, events, views, services, verbs, slots, collections, mod points, presentation module, target parity, changelog, examples of a config and of a mod). For a compact Markdown form use gripforge_gamekit_api.

version.description: Exact version to read (e.g. 1.0.0). Default: latest.

with_usage.description: true to include usedBy: the workspace projects where this kit is installed.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_gamekit_get
title: Read one Game Kit
